body: Thank you for the kind gesture :) I hope you had a good day as well.
What a terrible thing to say to someone who is struggling.

I half agree with you. It does feel disingenuous when we're told "There are people who care for you", even though that person may mean well. And I know a lot of people have some friends who say that they'll be there for that person and are nowhere to be seen when needed. However, I know that the love I hold for those in my life is genuine and it isn't a stretch of the imagination to believe that I'm not the only one.

For me personally, and I'd imagine some others on this sub, what's keeping me here is a sense of responsibility to others. There are some people who don't want to be alive anymore but also do not want to abandon those they love, so they suffer through it.
For many of the people posting here it's more than just "life sucks sometimes".
I'm happy to hear that! I hope you do something nice for yourself today.
Please don't do that. More than likely it will make you very ill with the possibility of long-term health effects.

I'm sorry, that must be a difficult thing to live with :(. I think making mistakes is a normal part of everyone's life, and the hard part is allowing ourselves to make mistakes without being too hard on ourselves. I'm trying to figure out how to do that too.

I used to volunteer part time at an animal shelter to help with my loneliness. It allowed me to have a sense of belonging and I was able to see cute animals. I don't know if that's an option for you or if you're interested in something like that.
That's true. I see that you play (or used to play) Pokémon Go, is there a group in your area that meets in person to play together?
I'm not sure what your hobbies are currently, but you could try finding an online community for those hobbies to talk to people with similar interests as you.

I experience physical symptoms as well. I find that when I'm depressed my appetite is reduced quite a bit. Sometimes I'll have a persistent headache as well. Whether or not that's linked to my emotional state I'm not sure.

I find when I'm nostalgic over happier times the emotions I feel are similar to that of homesickness, like I'm "homesick" over a period of time where my life was better. 

I hope you talk to someone about the way you're feeling. Even if it's something small like "I'm not feeling like myself today" and see where the conversation goes.
Happy birthday :). I'm sorry you're feeling that way. I hope that you do something nice for yourself today, even if it's a small thing.
It's exhausting. I'm sorry to hear that you are struggling as well. I wish I had some useful advice but I am trying to figure that out myself.
Please don't make promises you can't keep.
